teach.text: Three more signs complete the system:

**Sukun** ( ْ ): a small circle. The letter has **no vowel** after it.
بَيْت = bayt (house)   كَلْب = kalb (dog)   شَمْس = shams (sun)

**Shadda** ( ّ ): a small «w» shape. The letter is **doubled** (said twice, with stress).
أُمّ = umm (mother)   جَدّ = jadd (grandfather)   مُعَلِّم = mu'allim (teacher)

**Tanween**: a doubled vowel mark at the end of a word that adds an **-n** sound.
كِتَابٌ = kitaabun   كِتَابًا = kitaaban   كِتَابٍ = kitaabin
Tanween is only ever on the LAST letter of a word. It is the sound «-un / -an / -in» added to the end.

practice.prompt: The sign ْ (sukun) means the letter has:
practice.explain: Sukun = no vowel after that letter.

practice.prompt: The sign ّ (shadda) means the letter is:
practice.explain: Shadda doubles the letter: أُمّ = umm.
The sukun on ل means no vowel after it: kalb.
